claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented the feature request. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Changes Made

### 1. Added `renderSummary()` function to `src/gate/report.ts`
- Generates one-line summaries for CI logs with format: `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>`
- Counts answered checks (7 total) excluding those with block-severity findings
- Appends blocked check IDs in GATE_CHECKS order if any blocks exist
- Special handling for missing gate section: returns `BLOCK 0/7: structure`

### 2. Added `--summary` flag to the CLI (`src/cli.ts`)
- Outputs only the summary line instead of the full report
- Exit codes preserved (1 for BLOCK, 0 for PASS/WARN)
- `--json` takes priority if both flags provided

### 3. Updated HELP text
- Documented the new `--summary` flag with example output

### 4. Comprehensive test coverage (`src/gate/report.test.ts`)
- 7 new tests covering all scenarios:
  - PASS with all checks answered
  - WARN with warnings only
  - BLOCK with multiple check failures
  - Missing gate section (structure case)
  - Multiple findings from same check
  - Proper ID ordering

### 5. Exported `renderSummary()` from package index
- Available to library consumers via `export { renderSummary }`

**Test Results:** ✅ All 18 tests pass (7 new + 11 existing)
